effectContract.attribution: separately identified Ntilde effect contract; not the pinned probe

pinned.demand: the exact pinned BEL-terminated request on the untouched default is answered by the complete declared declaration, ST-terminated

st-terminated.demand: the same request ended by ST is answered by the same ST-terminated reply

repeat.demand: two requests in one exchange are answered by two identical replies in request order

silent-forms.demand: a bare Capabilities form and a query spelling change nothing and stay silent

silent-assignment.demand: an unsolicited Capabilities assignment changes nothing and stays silent

silent-suffix.demand: a suffixed request changes nothing and stays silent

silent-case.demand: both wrong-case spellings change nothing and stay silent

recover.demand: after the silent forms the exact request is still answered by the same reply, so silence never broke the framing

conclusion.scope: the iTerm2 feature-reporting declaration (OSC 1337 RequestCapabilities/Capabilities) only: the exact pinned request, the ST-terminated reply framing, the declared code string with Cw (the direct pane's host accepts OSC 52 writes under the run's default initial settings), reply count and correlation, the silent boundaries for unsolicited, suffixed and wrong-case payloads and recovery after them; the Cw-omitted host state, the per-code behavior of every declared capability and the image and cell-size forms are owned elsewhere; raw replies and unchanged state, no rendering, painted-pixel, remote/mux, common-harness or score claim, and the pinned probe alone never establishes which capabilities are honestly advertised
